input.title: Finance notifications

missing_information: What specific rule determines whether an email notification should be sent for an approved transfer?
Which actor or system is responsible for sending the transfer notifications?

priority_reasons: Priority cannot be fully justified due to fundamental contradictions in the requirement, making its impact dependent on the resolution of the conflicting statements.
analysis.improved_requirement: The system shall process approved transfers and [TO BE CONFIRMED: send an email notification for every approved transfer / never send email notifications for approved transfers].
